Test Data Licensing
===================

This directory contains test data for the inkcheck project.

All test files in this directory are either:

1. Public Domain (CC0 1.0 Universal)
   - Files created specifically for testing
   - Dedicated to the public domain
   - No copyright or related rights reserved

2. Public Domain (expired copyright)
   - Historical texts from Project Gutenberg
   - Copyright has expired

3. Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA)
   - Simple Wikipedia content
   - Must provide attribution when redistributed

See individual files for specific licensing information.
